claims: Poppy Kennedy McIlroy was born on August 31, 2020, at 12:15 p.m. in Jupiter, Florida.
Poppy Kennedy McIlroy is the only child of Rory McIlroy and Erica Stoll.
Erica Stoll is the wife of Rory McIlroy.
Rory McIlroy and Erica Stoll chose the name Poppy after considering other flower-based names like Rose and Iris.
Following his 2026 Masters win, Rory McIlroy celebrated with his wife and daughter at Augusta.
Poppy Kennedy McIlroy has appeared at the Masters Par 3 contest multiple times since 2023.
Rory McIlroy has described his daughter as a positive influence who puts his life and career into perspective.
Rory McIlroy has described Poppy Kennedy McIlroy as "unbelievably polite, respectful, and well-behaved".
